## 2024-05-24 — PII in audit logs redacted
**Data traced:** Email addresses (PII)
**Exposure found:** Plaintext email addresses within the 'author' and 'details' fields of the in-memory audit logs generated by `createAuditLog`
**Fix:** Applied irreversible redaction to the 'author' and 'details' fields in `createAuditLog` before storing, while ensuring cryptographic hash generation still uses unredacted data to preserve integrity
**Coverage confirmed:** Verified that logs stored in memory have emails redacted while hash continues to use unredacted data by examining source modifications
**Still exposed elsewhere:** Other files were not deeply scanned for additional unredacted PII in this session
